available_subtitle: 从 Godot 官方发布版本中获取。
no_versions_match: 没有匹配的已安装版本
no_available_versions_match: 没有匹配的可下载版本
switch_to_archive: 切换到 Godot 发布存档
current_set_desc: {{tag}} is now reachable through the alias below.
current_path_hint: Add the folder above to your PATH to run "Godot" from any terminal, script, or tool. The alias always follows the current version, so pinning another version or uninstalling this one updates it automatically.
current_shim_note: Windows symlinks need Developer Mode or admin rights, so a launcher script was created instead. It behaves the same from the command line.
aliases_desc: Create extra command names that point at a specific Godot version, so scripts, tests and tools can call them by name.
aliases_empty: No aliases yet. Pick a version above, give the command a name, and it will appear in the aliases folder.
aliases_no_versions: Install a Godot version first to create an alias.
aliases_path_hint: Add the aliases folder to your PATH to run these names from any terminal or tool. The "Godot" command from the current version pin lives in the same folder.
alias_remove_desc: The command "{{name}}" will stop working. The Godot version itself stays installed.
alias_mono_script_note: Mono builds load GodotSharp from the folder next to the executable, so on Windows the alias is created as a launcher script instead of a link.
